raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The B200 DeepGEMM release test job [exceeded its 60-minute limit](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38864289997/job/116854382412) while still progressing through `test_fp8_fp4.py`, before reaching the MegaMoE and sanitizer tests.

## Modifications

Increase the `8-gpu-b200` matrix timeout in `release-whl-deepgemm.yml` from 60 to 180 minutes, matching the existing GB300 limit.

## Accuracy Tests

- `pre-commit run --files .github/workflows/release-whl-deepgemm.yml` passed.
- YAML validation confirmed the only semantic change is B200's timeout and that the job uses `matrix.timeout`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- GPU tests were not rerun for this workflow-only change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; this changes the CI time limit only.
